# allinkl_ftp_user (Resource)

Manages an additional FTP login of the all-inkl.com (KAS) account. The account's own login is not manageable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A login that may read and list the access logs, nothing else.
resource "allinkl_ftp_user" "logs" {
  path     = "/logs/"
  comment  = "log reader"
  password = var.ftp_password
  write    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `comment` (String) Free text describing the login. KAS requires one.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) FTP password. Write-only: drift is not detectable; changing the value updates it. As with all Terraform secrets, the value is stored in the state file.

### Optional

- `list` (Boolean) May list directories.
- `path` (String) Directory the login is confined to, relative to the account root.
- `read` (Boolean) May download files.
- `virus_scan` (Boolean) Scan uploads with ClamAV.
- `write` (Boolean) May upload, change and delete files.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) KAS-assigned login, e.g. `f0123456`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import allinkl_ftp_user.logs f0123456
```
